answer: The stored knowledge does not record who signed an external penetration-test engagement for Cinder, or an approved fee for one. The plain Cinder service page (wiki/cinder-service.md) contains only operational notes (internal inventory sync twice daily, service owner Neri Vale) and has no security-review section. Two related entities are not the same as Cinder: Cinder-Sandbox has an engagement signed by Hana Ines with an approved fee of $27000, and Cinder-Legacy's service page states that no penetration-test engagement record is stored. Neither applies to Cinder itself, so I have not attributed either to Cinder.
limitations: Searches for penetration-test, pentest, and Cinder-plus-signed/fee terms over the wiki found no Cinder-specific engagement record. Results were truncated for broad queries, so I did not review every page's full security section. The absence is only in the retrieved evidence and does not prove no engagement exists. Cinder-Sandbox's signer and fee are reported only as a different entity and are not an answer for Cinder.
